summary: All five requirements are substantially implemented. A reusable PaginationControls component and usePagination hook were created (REQ-1), and pagination was applied to FileList/Dashboard (REQ-2), SharedWithMe/SharedByMe (REQ-3), Trash with separate file/folder pagination instances (REQ-4), and Recent (REQ-5). One minor gap exists: the Previous button in PaginationControls uses CSS opacity/pointer-events to fake disabling rather than a proper HTML disabled attribute, but this is a minor implementation detail. All core requirements appear satisfied.
